section_header: FRONT AXLE AND SUSPENSION — Front Suspension
title: INSTALLATION OF LOWER ARM

content.description: Installation diagram showing rack boot protector location during lower arm installation
Diagram showing stabilizer bar and strut bar connection points to lower arm

content.text: 2. CONNECT STABILIZER BAR AND STRUT BAR TO LOWER ARM

items: (a) Connect the stabilizer bar to the lower arm with the bolt and nut. Torque the nut.
(b) Connect the strut bar to the lower arm with the two nuts. Torque the nuts.

content.description: Diagram showing knuckle arm connection to ball joint and tie rod

content.text: 3. CONNECT KNUCKLE ARM TO BALL JOINT AND TIE ROD

items: (a) Install the knuckle arm on the ball joint with a nut. Torque the nut and install a new cotter pin.
(b) Install the knuckle arm on the tie rod with a nut. Torque the nut and install a new cotter pin.

content.description: Diagram showing knuckle arm connection to shock absorber assembly

content.text: 4. CONNECT KNUCKLE ARM TO SHOCK ABSORBER
Place the shock absorber assembly in position and connect the knuckle and with the two bolts. Torque the bolts.

content.description: Diagram showing bolt location for lower arm to crossmember connection

content.text: 6. TORQUE BOLT HOLDING LOWER ARM TO CROSS-MEMBER
After bouncing the vehicle to settle the suspension, torque the bolt.
7. CHECK FRONT WHEEL ALIGNMENT AND SIDE SLIP
